subject: Mathematics
title: Matrices and Determinants
summary: Matrix = numbers ki rectangular table (m × n). Do matrices tabhi multiply hote hain jab pehle ke columns = doosre ke rows; aur AB aksar BA ke barabar nahi hota — order matter karta hai.
Determinant sirf square matrix ka ek number hai. Ye batata hai matrix 'ulta' ho sakta hai ya nahi: |A| ≠ 0 ⇒ inverse exist karta hai (non-singular).
Inverse adjoint se: A⁻¹ = adj A / |A|. adj A ke determinant, adj of adj, |kA| — in sab ke power wale formulas JEE ke favourite hain.
Linear equations AX = B: |A| ≠ 0 to unique solution X = A⁻¹B. |A| = 0 to ya to koi solution nahi ya infinite — (adj A)B (ya Cramer ke D₁, D₂, D₃) se check karo.
Determinant se triangle ka area aur collinearity bhi nikalti hai.

formulas.name: Types of matrices
formulas.formula: Square, diagonal, scalar, identity I, zero O, upper/lower triangular, symmetric (Aᵀ = A), skew-symmetric (Aᵀ = −A, diagonal sab 0)
formulas.mistake: Skew-symmetric ki diagonal entries hamesha zero.

formulas.name: Special square matrices
formulas.formula: Orthogonal: AAᵀ = I.  Idempotent: A² = A.  Involutory: A² = I.  Nilpotent: Aᵏ = O (kisi k ke liye)

formulas.name: Matrix multiplication
formulas.formula: (m × n)(n × p) = (m × p);   (AB)ᵢⱼ = Σₖ aᵢₖ bₖⱼ
formulas.mistake: AB = O hone par bhi A ya B zero ho, zaroori nahi; AB = AC se B = C nahi nikalta.

formulas.name: Transpose rules
formulas.formula: (Aᵀ)ᵀ = A,  (A + B)ᵀ = Aᵀ + Bᵀ,  (kA)ᵀ = kAᵀ,  (AB)ᵀ = BᵀAᵀ

formulas.name: Symmetric + skew-symmetric split
formulas.when: Kisi bhi square matrix ko todna (unique tareeka).

formulas.name: Determinant of order 2 and 3
formulas.formula: |a b; c d| = ad − bc.   3 × 3: kisi bhi row/column ke along expand: |A| = a₁₁C₁₁ + a₁₂C₁₂ + a₁₃C₁₃
formulas.mistake: Jis row/column mein zyada zero ho, usi ke along expand karo.

formulas.name: Minor and cofactor
formulas.formula: Mᵢⱼ = row i, column j hata ke bacha determinant;   Cᵢⱼ = (−1)^{i+j} Mᵢⱼ

formulas.name: Properties of determinants
formulas.formula: |Aᵀ| = |A|;  do rows swap → sign ulta;  do rows same/proportional → 0;  ek row × k → |A| × k;  Rᵢ → Rᵢ + kRⱼ → koi badlaav nahi;  triangular → diagonal ka product
formulas.when: Bina poora expand kiye determinant simplify karna.
formulas.mistake: Kisi ek row ki entries ko kisi doosri row ke cofactors se multiply karke jodo → 0.

formulas.name: Determinant of products and scalars
formulas.mistake: |kA| mein k ki power = order, sirf k nahi.

formulas.name: Adjoint
formulas.formula: adj A = (cofactor matrix)ᵀ;   A (adj A) = (adj A) A = |A| I

formulas.name: Adjoint properties
formulas.formula: |adj A| = |A|^{n−1};   adj(adj A) = |A|^{n−2} A;   |adj(adj A)| = |A|^{(n−1)²};   adj(AB) = (adj B)(adj A);   adj(Aᵀ) = (adj A)ᵀ

formulas.name: Area of triangle and collinearity
formulas.formula: Area = ½ |det [x₁ y₁ 1; x₂ y₂ 1; x₃ y₃ 1]|;   collinear ⇔ det = 0
formulas.when: Teen points se area / ek line par hain ya nahi.

formulas.name: System AX = B (non-homogeneous)
formulas.formula: |A| ≠ 0: unique, X = A⁻¹B.   |A| = 0 aur (adj A)B ≠ O: koi solution nahi.   |A| = 0 aur (adj A)B = O: infinite ya koi nahi (aage check karo)

formulas.name: Cramer's rule
formulas.formula: x = D₁/D, y = D₂/D, z = D₃/D  (D ≠ 0).   D = 0, koi Dᵢ ≠ 0: no solution.   D = 0 aur D₁ = D₂ = D₃ = 0: infinite ya none
formulas.mistake: Dᵢ = D mein i-th column ko B se badal ke.

formulas.name: Homogeneous system AX = O
formulas.formula: Hamesha consistent (x = y = z = 0).   Non-trivial solution ⇔ |A| = 0
formulas.when: 'Non-zero solution ke liye k?' wale sawal.

formulas.name: Trace
formulas.formula: tr(A + B) = tr A + tr B,   tr(kA) = k tr A,   tr(AB) = tr(BA)

examples.title: Power wale determinants
examples.problem: A 3 × 3 matrix hai, |A| = 4. |adj A|, |adj(adj A)| aur |2A|?

examples.title: Teen equations solve karo
examples.solution: D = |1 1 1; 1 −1 1; 2 1 −1| = 6 ≠ 0 ⇒ unique solution. Cramer / A⁻¹B se: x = 1, y = 2, z = 3. (Pehli − doosri se 2y = 4 ⇒ y = 2 bhi turant.)

examples.title: Infinite solutions ke liye k
examples.problem: x + y + z = 1,  x + 2y + 3z = 2,  x + 3y + kz = 3. Kis k par infinitely many solutions?
examples.solution: D = |1 1 1; 1 2 3; 1 3 k| = k − 5. Unique ke liye k ≠ 5. k = 5 par: (eq2 − eq1) aur (eq3 − eq2) dono y + 2z = 1 dete hain ⇒ consistent ⇒ infinitely many. Answer k = 5.

examples.title: Non-trivial solution
examples.problem: kx + y + z = 0,  x + ky + z = 0,  x + y + kz = 0 — non-trivial solution kab?

examples.title: Cayley–Hamilton se inverse
examples.problem: A = [1 2; 3 4]. A⁻¹ ko A ke terms mein likho.

topics.title: Matrix ka order aur equality
topics.explain: Order m × n = m rows, n columns. Do matrices barabar tabhi jab order same aur har entry same. Addition sirf same order mein.

topics.title: Multiplication ke gun
topics.explain: Associative (AB)C = A(BC), distributive A(B + C) = AB + AC, lekin commutative nahi (AB ≠ BA aam taur par). I identity: AI = IA = A. Isliye (A + B)² = A² + AB + BA + B², A² + 2AB + B² tabhi jab AB = BA.

topics.title: Symmetric aur skew-symmetric
topics.explain: AAᵀ aur A + Aᵀ hamesha symmetric; A − Aᵀ skew-symmetric. Do symmetric ka product symmetric tabhi jab wo commute karein. Skew-symmetric ki diagonal zero, aur odd order mein determinant zero.

topics.title: Determinant evaluate karne ki strategy
topics.explain: Pehle properties lagao: common factor bahar nikaalo, Rᵢ → Rᵢ − Rⱼ se zero banao, phir zero wali row/column ke along expand karo. Do rows proportional dikhen to turant 0.

topics.title: Adjoint aur inverse
topics.explain: Cofactors nikaalo, transpose karo = adj A. Phir |A| se divide. Check hamesha karo: A × A⁻¹ = I. Singular matrix (|A| = 0) ka inverse nahi hota.

topics.title: Consistency ka poora flow
topics.explain: Step 1: |A| nikaalo. ≠ 0 ⇒ unique. Step 2: = 0 ⇒ (adj A)B nikaalo. ≠ O ⇒ inconsistent (no solution). = O ⇒ equations ko compare/eliminate karke dekho: aapas mein consistent to infinite, warna none.

topics.title: Homogeneous system
topics.explain: x = y = z = 0 hamesha ek solution (trivial). Agar |A| = 0 to infinite non-trivial bhi. 'k ki values jinke liye non-zero solution' = |A| = 0 solve karo.

topics.title: Determinant ka geometric matlab
topics.explain: 2D mein |det| = do vectors se bane parallelogram ka area; teen points ke liye ½|det| = triangle area. Area 0 ⇒ teeno points ek line par.

ratta: |kA| = kⁿ|A|;  |adj A| = |A|^{n−1};  |adj adj A| = |A|^{(n−1)²};  adj adj A = |A|^{n−2} A.
A·adj A = |A| I;  A⁻¹ = adj A/|A|.
(AB)ᵀ = BᵀAᵀ;  (AB)⁻¹ = B⁻¹A⁻¹;  adj(AB) = adj B · adj A.
D ≠ 0 unique;  D = 0 & koi Dᵢ ≠ 0 → no solution.
Area = ½|det| (1 wala column);  det = 0 ⇒ collinear.
